Version 1.0.3 Release

Why:

* There are some bugs that need squashin.

Handle dark mode.

Why:

* The icon is hard to see in darkmode.

This change addresses the need by:

* Check current appearance when rendering the menu in order to know
  whether or not to display a dark or light icon.
* Add an observer to see when the apearance has changed and rerender the
  menu icon.

Side effects:

* The icon is now visible when in dark mode.

Use new status url.

Why:

* Github deprecated and removed the old one.

This change addresses the need by:

* Use https://githubstatus.com/ over https://githubstatus.com/

Side effects:

* The app works again as it previously continuously warned the user
  about github's status over and over again.
Make some project updates recommended by XCode.
Release 1.0.2: Fix crash from null path.

Fix crash from null path.

Why:

* There are times that Github will pass a null subject
  latest_comment_url which will cause a crash if we don't default back
  to the subject url.

This change addresses the need by:

* Add a check for a null path from Github for the subject latest_comment_url.
* Update AFNetworking to the latest patch for version 1.*.*.

Fix #40: New Version Notification doesn't post.

Why:

* The old apps won't correctly post that there is a new version of the
  app unless there are no notifications in the Mac User Notification
  Center.

This change addresses the need by:

* Fix a backwards logic operator (i.e. '!=' -> '==').
* Release version 1.0.1.

Release version 1.0.0!

Why:

* The app is now stable and follows [semver](http://semver.org/)
* There are a couple bug fixes that are important to release.

This change addresses the need by:

* Add a CHANGELOG.md for human readable changes.
* Update version identifier to 1.0.0.
* Set default Log Level to Warn.

Fix #38: Multiple Github status notifications.

Why:

* When a new Github status is posted as a notification, then the latest
  notification should replace the old Github status notification if
  there is one in existence.

This change addresses the need by:

* Remove all Github status notifications before posting a new one.

Fix #39: Notifications continue to repeat/build up

Why:

* The Mac User Notification Center only keeps a list of at max 20
  notifications that have been shown. This causes issues once there are
  more than 20 Github notifications as it will find notifications that
  have been shown not in the list of the 20.

This change addresses the need by:

* Once there are more than 20 Github notifications:
  * Remove all active Mac User Notifications that are for a Github
    notification.
  * Add a notification that has the total count of notifications that
    when clicked will take the user to the Github notification page.
  * Reshow the count notification whenever the count changes.
  * List the count as "50+" when the count is 50 as that is the maximum
    number of notifications we will receive from Github.
* If the count was above 20 and falls back to 20 or lower, then remove
  the count notification if there is one and show individual Github
  notifications again.
v0.4.0 Release
Resolves #27: Monitor status.github.com api for issues.
Refactors GithubAvatar to be OonNotificationContentImage.
Resolves #24: On install ask if the app should start the app on login.
Resolves #37: Add repo owner avatar to mac notification.

Now uses the bundle version to check for new release.

This also removes the kAppVersion constant since it is no longer needed
as well as increments the build number. The notification center app icon
cache is cleared due to incrementing the build number so that the new
app icon shows up rather than the default mac app icon.
Moves Images.xcassets into the Supporting Files xcode group.

Fixes #32: Comment header files.

This also removes an unused property from the AFGithubClient class.

Resolves #13: Create an icon

This adds a simple blue circle as the icon.

Fixes #30: Notification should always be marked as read when clicked.

Currently the notification only gets marked as read when the user is
logged in when they click the notification on the mac.

Repro steps:

Log out of github in your default browser
Click a mac objective octocat notification on your mac
The notification will be removed from the mac, yet it will show up again
next time it checks for notifications since the notification is still
unread on github.

Fixes #36: Upgrade from <= 0.2.0 to 0.3.0 can result in no notification.

This is due to the fact that in 0.3.0 we started reading the
notification repo url with issue #25 so we can provide a more direct
url. That requires an OAuth token with the repo permission. Which we
don't have in versions 0.2.0 and lower.

If we fail to get a direct url to a notification and get a http status
code 401 or 404 we will ask for a new OAuth token.

Resolves #18: Check for new releases should work without authentication.

We want the checkForNewRelease method to work with the least amount of
code that way it will mitigate the risk of it being affected by a bug.

Resolves #1: Create a log function that will only log for debug builds

Currently we use NSLog across the app. It would be good to have a way to
set the log level. That way a production build doesn't spam the system
logs, but still has the usefulness of feedback when developing.
Release 0.3.0.

Resolves #31: Update status menu to use native mac menu.

This makes it easier to update the menu items and greatly simplifies the
code.

Resolves #25: Click on notification should go to a more direct url.

Unfortunately this also means that we need to have a OAuth token with
repo access in order to view the more direct urls.
Removing extra whitespace from source.

Merge pull request #28 from squaresurf/issue-8

Fixes #8: Stop using time to decide which notifications to ignore.
Update README.md
v1.1.0: Updates database creation to allow setting options.
Updates specs to work with the latest ChefSpec.
Updates to pass latest version of rubocop.
Removed version locks on Gemfile in favor of lock file.
Updates Gemfile.lock to work with the Ruby 2.2.1 and Yosemite.
Fix typos in README.md.
v0.1.0: The vault should be ready to use.
First commit with README.md and LICENSE.

Version 1.0.0!

- Bicycle class hierarchy to show how to test inheritence.
- Bicycle interface tests to test liskov substitution principle.
- Bicycle Subclass tests.
- Bicycle Superclass enforcement tests.
- Test Concrete Subclass Behavior
- Test Abstract Superclass Behavior
- Disclaimer to the README.md

- Bug with Bicycle#initialize as it did not use the default\_\* methods for initialization.

Update spec description to be easier to read.

Why:

* The name in the spec was confusing.

This change addresses the need by:

* Update the spec describe string.

Test Abstract Superclass Behavior

Why:

* There was superclass behavior that still need coverage from our tests.

This change addresses the need by:

* Add a StubbedBike class to verify abstract behavior.
* Add a test for Bicycle#local_spares to ensure it is mergable when not
  overridden by a subclass.
* Fix case in CHANGELOG.md.
* Fix bug with Bicycle#initialize as it did not use the default_*
  methods for initialization.

Test concrete subclass behavior.

Why:

* There is behavior that is specific to the RoadBike class that should
  be tested in the RoadBike tests.

This change addresses the need by:

* Add tests for specific RoadBike behavior tothe RoadBike tests.

Add bicycle superclass enforcement tests.

Why:

* There is behaviour that bicycle itself should test as it is
  responsible for enforcing certain methods exist for subclasses.

This change addresses the need by:

* Add tests to ensure that default_tire_size raises an exception if not
  implemented.

Add Bicycle Subclass tests.

Why:

* It is good to ensure that your subclass respect the Liskov
  Substitution Principle.

This change addresses the need by:

* Add a shared bicycle subclass test for the road bike class.

Add Bicycle class hierarchy.

Why:

* Bicycle class hierarchy is an example of how to test inheritence.

This change addresses the need by:

* Add Bicycle class.
* Add RoadBike class which is a subclass of Bicycle.
* Add Bicycle interface tests to test liskov substitution principle.

Use role tests to validate doubles.

Why:

* Doubles can get stale and make tests green when they shouldn't.
  Therefore, they should be tested with the same interface tests as
  the Duck Type they're playing.

This change addresses the need by:

* Change Wheel#diameter -> Wheel#width in order to follow the book.
* Add diameterizable interface test module and set up wheel and
  diameterizable double to use it to verify the duck type role.
* Add diameterizable interface shared example and updated wheel spec and
  wheel double in the gear spec to use it to verify their duck type
  interfaces.

Add examples for testing roles.

Why:

* It is important to test the roles of duck types without repeating
  yourself.

This change addresses the need by:

* Add duck type examples and tests.
* Add duck type consumer example and tests.

Order lib includes alphabetically.

Why:

* It makes it easier to read and add new libraries without thinking
  about order. If order is neede then it can be required first with a
  space between itself and the group of alphabetically ordered list.

This change addresses the need by:

* Sort requires alphabetically in the the lib/poodr_rspec.rb file.

Moved SimpleCov start to the .simplecov file.

Why:

* Starting SimpleCov in a .simplecov file lets us share configuration
  between RSpec and MiniTest.
* Sharing config allows us to ignore test files from coverage easier.
* Ignoring test files from coverage helps give us a better picture of
  coverage.

This change addresses the need by:

* Remove SimpleCov.start from RSpec and MiniTest helpers.
* Add a .simplecov file with the SimpleCov.start call and config.

Use MiniTest::Test.

Why:

* MiniTest::Unit::TestCase is deprecated.

This change addresses the need by:

* Update tests to extend MiniTest::Test instead of MiniTest::Unit::TestCase.

Add pry gem.

Why:

* Pry helps with debugging.

This change addresses the need by:

* Add pry gem to the Gemfile in a development group.

Add Proving Command Messages Examples

Why:

* It is important to ensure your application sends command messages.

This change addresses the need by:

* Add observer example code to the Gear class.
* Add tests and specs.

Inject Dependencies as Roles

Why:

* It can speed up tests.
* Tests that the code needs a role rather than a specific class.

This change addresses the need by:

* Use a double for Wheel in the Gear tests.

Isolate object under test.

Why:

* The Gear class should accept an object diameterizable rather than
  initialize an instance of the Wheel class.

This change addresses the need by:

* Update gear and tests to accept a wheel instance in the initializer.

Release v0.1.0.

Why:

* We now have example classes and tests.

This change addresses the need by:

* Update CHANGELOG.md.

Add first iteration of Gear and Wheel.

Why:

- Implement the examples from the first section with examples.

This change addresses the need by:

- Add the Gear Class, MiniTest, and RSpec.
- Add the Wheel Class, MiniTest, and RSpec.

Update travis to use .ruby-version.

Why:

* We can make sure that travis is always using the correct ruby version
  by using the .ruby-version file and enforcing it in the Gemfile.

This change addresses the need by:

* Add .ruby-version file using 2.3.0 instead of 2.2.4.
* Update Gemfile to lock ruby version to the version in the
  .ruby-version file.
* Remove explicit ruby version in the travis file.

Release v0.0.1.

Why:

* We are finished setting up the codebase and are ready to start writing
  example classes and tests!

This change addresses the need by:

* Update CHANGELOG.md to move unreleased items into v0.0.1.
* Update CHANGELOG.md to have a link for the v0.0.1 diff.

Add test coverage and remove extra tests.

Why:

* Test coverage will show us any code paths that don't have tests.
* The extra tests where failing the tests suites with no benefit.

This change addresses the need by:

* Add SimpleCov and Coveralls.
* Remove stubbed out tests that asserted false was true.

Add rubocop config to not require class comments.

Why:

* Class comments would just add noise since they would not be copied
  from the examples from the book.

This change addresses the need by:

* Add a rubocop config that is set to not require class comments.

Fix license link in readme.

Why:

* It is useful to have a link to the full license in the README.

This change addresses the need by:

* Update the link to include the extension.

Initial commit.

Why:

We need a basic library to write example code as well as a way to test
with MiniTest and RSpec.

This change addresses the need by:

* Set up a library for examples.
* Set up MiniTest scaffold.
* Set up RSpec scaffold.
